proposed_facts.reason: Canonical calls pass NULL matrices and zero scalars; xD0C reaches the independent numeric palette selector. Both position-zeroing sites are present. Compiled-section attribution is explicitly and appropriately deferred.
Canonical guards establish the described hurtbox traversal conditions, and local position initialization precedes owner tests whenever the model-enabled branch is entered.
Definition and header both declare Vec3*, not const Vec3*. The nullable offset is only read, and pass conversion and hierarchy submission match the explanation.
Dispatch inputs, numeric override, NULL matrices, accumulated boolean result and conditional cleanup match canonical code. The downstream renderer writes endpoint caches and skip_update_pos.
The diagnostic mapping is retained correctly while acknowledging canonical endpoint-cache mutations; neither hurtbox renderer assigns the collision-state classification.
Special-kind and ordinary-path gates match the source. The override renderer forces palette index 2 for intangible hurtboxes, separately checks the pass, and receives a NULL matrix.

Configuration writes have no save/restore, camera cases are limited to the stated combinations, owner-offset refresh is conditional, and collision cleanup is independent of model eligibility. Supporting joint helpers confirm show/hide operations rather than arbitrary visibility restoration.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral for the four unresolved section facts and two unresolved section links: the source establishes the color initializer, its use, zero arguments and position initialization, but does not establish compiled section extent, ownership or pooled-storage identity.

The transform interpretation in facts 57ba2f3f, 37ac907a and 2c6e4857 is contradicted by separate numeric palette and matrix parameters. The proposed corrections preserve the intangible exception and ordinary-state branch.
Fact 073f2f4d incorrectly restricted position zeroing. Independently read canonical lines confirm initialization before owner tests. The malformed upstream locator was not used as evidence.
Fact 868cab78 confused read-only use with declared const qualification; the proposed signature correction matches both declaration and definition.
Fact 1c0a28b0 omitted downstream mutations. Both hurtbox renderers conditionally populate endpoint caches and set skip_update_pos, while retaining the diagnostic role.

Fact 4d112ab1 incorrectly described temporary display flags. The source writes persistent configurations and has no default model submission. Bone operations reverse configured groups without saving arbitrary incoming visibility.
